## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`. `record:details` read mode shows a `textarea` through the fields package's own read display, which keeps line breaks

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-03T20:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Measured now (objectui `origin/main` `09036173c5`):** `packages/fields/src/widgets/TextAreaField.tsx:96` renders its read value in a `whitespace-pre-wrap` block. `record:details` read mode does not reach it.

**Why p3.** It is display only: the stored value keeps its breaks, and edit mode carries them since objectui#11562. A multi-line note reads as one paragraph on the record page.

**Routing:** `packages/plugin-detail`, the read-mode value rendering, so `domain:ui`.

**Direction: the read-mode half of objectui#11562.**
- Read mode draws a `textarea` value through the fields package's own read display (`TextAreaField`'s), as edit mode now routes to its editor.
- ⛔ No second hand-written `pre-wrap` copy in `plugin-detail` if the shared display can be reached.
- **Pins:**
  - a value with `\n\n` and a trailing newline reads back with its breaks in read mode;
  - a single-line value is unchanged;
  - other plain-text types are unchanged.

## ✅ ACCEPT: PR objectui#11602 at head `897bd535d` (dev report `5978339688`); it lands through the merge queue when every check is green

`domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01FjqrwXPfSMkSfkKYDSRkN2` · 2026-10-04T09:03Z. Reviewed against GitHub, not the report.

- **Shape:** draft, base `main`. The first line is `Fixes #11577`, with no other closing keyword. `Clause-②: no` is at line start. 3 files, +247 / −1. `check-governed-merges`: NOT governed. The PR assignee is `os-zhuang`.
- **`Clause-②: no` re-checked:** `TextAreaField` and `coerceToSafeValue` were already exports of `@object-ui/fields`, and no package-index export moves in either package. `patch` ✓.
- **Triage `5973392794`, carried out:**
  - In `DetailSection.tsx`, a row whose resolved type is `textarea` renders `TextAreaField` with `readonly`, ahead of `getCellRenderer`. That is the widget's own `whitespace-pre-wrap` read branch, the display the record form uses.
  - There is no hand-written `pre-wrap` copy in `plugin-detail`, and `TextAreaField.tsx` is untouched.
  - The cell-renderer table's `textarea` → `TextCellRenderer` mapping stays, so grid cells keep their one-line display.
  - The value goes through `String(coerceToSafeValue(value))`, the same input `TextCellRenderer` drew from. An empty value never reaches this branch: this seat read the `hasCellValue` guard just above it, which renders the shared `EmptyValue`.
- **Pins:** `record-details.textareaReadDisplay-11577` mounts the real `RecordDetailsRenderer` on desktop and mobile:
  - a value with `\n\n` and a trailing newline reads back with its breaks;
  - a single-line control reads back as the same text;
  - `text` and `email` controls are unchanged.

  Ablating the `textarea` route turns exactly the 4 multi-line cases red, and it was restored by blob hash. The whole `plugin-detail` package is green: 234 files, 2,321 tests. So are 73 outside files selected by import and by source-text read. A real-Chromium before/after on the console reads the stored value with both breaks after the fix.
- **Accepted behaviour note:** a long single-line `textarea` value now wraps at the column width instead of ending in an ellipsis. That matches the record form's read-only field, and the changeset says so.
- **Out-of-scope readings, all Acceptance notes** (no class a/b/c with a measured reach):
  - the `record:highlights` strip still draws a `textarea` as one line (a compact chip band, not this card's surface);
  - on the mobile grouped-inset row the value draws at `text-sm` where the row sets 15px;
  - a host `registerFieldRenderer('textarea', …)` override no longer reaches the details row. Zero producers were measured.
